title: centaurea heleniifolia
intro: Centaurea heleniifolia, commonly known as Yellow Kniff, is a flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea heleniifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
